provider_provenance record assembled by capabilities.provenance_for and stamped by findings.finalize_outcome onto the Pass-2 verify agent step must be wired through code-review.yaml and threaded to the terminal verdict assembly

_degraded_code_review_verdict outage path must omit provider_provenance rather than synthesizing it from config when no model ran, to avoid repeating the defect that provenance records exist to prevent

the Bedrock cutover target (review bot) cannot satisfy eb6es Bedrock-provenance acceptance criterion until code-review verdicts carry provider_provenance from the real assembly path to the signed sidecar payload
